_comment: FROZEN measurement, not a recomputed one. The /lab caveat quotes these figures and `npm run claims` checks them, so changing a number here without updating that caveat fails the build. Re-measuring means re-running the point-in-time CPCV described in ENGINE_TODO.md and updating both together.
method: 15 CPCV arrangements, 21-day horizon, 21-day embargo, membership applied as of each row's own date
lowerBoundReason: Applying membership by date removes companies that were not yet in the index. It cannot recover companies that were dropped and then failed, because their price history is gone.
